Deals 1440% of final ATK as additional damage.

caveats: ⚑ skill2 has NO activation clause in the kit text — the interval trigger and its 10s period are an INVENTED cadence (interval convention for clause-free damage lines). Total skill2 contribution scales 1:1 with this guess (180s / sec procs); pin it from a datamined skill cooldown or a focus recording before trusting any skill-bucket number.

⚑ Base weapon cadence (pulls/s from rate_of_fire) and reloadFrames=99 are datamine-unreliable fields; they set how fast the skill1 hitCount:30 window re-arms (AR hitsPerShot 1 ⇒ 30 rounds ≈ half a 60-round magazine), so buff UPTIME rides on them.

The burst's second 1440% branch is gated on the enemy being at Max HP. There is no target-HP model in v1 and no schema gate for it; at scope lock the boss is below Max HP from the opening shots, so every burst after t=0 fails the condition — the branch is recorded unmodeled rather than credited unconditionally. If a real fight ever shows the doubled burst popup (a first burst landing on an undamaged boss), this needs a target-HP gate primitive.
Both damage lines target 'the enemy with the highest final DEF'; the scope-lock fight has a single partless boss, so that selection is trivially the boss — modeled as target 'enemy'.

Both damage lines are function damage: crit at the caster's sheet rate, no core (the text never says 'core strike damage'), no +30% range (engine force-set). noFb is left unset (default FB-by-timing ON) for the skill2 rider; the burst cast is engine-exempt from the +50% Full Burst major because it resolves before the FB window opens.
override.note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. brid — AR/Water/Attacker/Burst III, ammo 60, hitsPerShot 1, cd 40s, no charge. S1 is a self ATK ▲18.52% for 10s re-armed every 30 rounds fired (~half a magazine), so uptime is high but not permanent and depends on the ⚑ cadence tuple. S2 is a single-target 211.2%-of-final-ATK function hit with no activation clause in the kit — modeled as an interval proc at a ⚑ estimated 10s period. Burst is a 1440%-of-final-ATK single-target hit on the owner's own burst cast. The burst's second 1440% branch (enemy at Max HP) is deliberately unmodeled: v1 has no target-HP model, and at scope lock the boss is already damaged before the first burst, so crediting it would over-count every rotation.

flags.estimate: interval{sec:10} — first fire at t=10s, ~17 procs over a 180s fight
flags.reasoning: ALWAYS-⚑ #2: the kit gives this 211.2% damage line NO activation clause at all, so both the trigger KIND and its period are invented. Convention for a clause-free damage line is `interval`; 10s is the roster-modal skill cooldown, not anything stated in this kit. Total skill-bucket damage from this line is exactly inversely proportional to the chosen period, so a 2× error here is a 2× error in the whole S2 contribution.
flags.recipe: Read the unit's datamined skillCooldownsSec entry for skill2 and set sec to it (first-fire convention: t=CD for an interval-style line with no 'Forcefully uses Skill N' wording). Independent confirmation: a camera-focus recording — count the 211.2% popups over a fixed window and divide, or diff sim-vs-real skill-bucket totals across two candidate periods.

flags.field: base cadence tuple (pullsPerSec / reloadFrames=99) — engine-side, not an override field
flags.estimate: AR datamined rate_of_fire as loaded; reload 99 frames (1.65s)
flags.reasoning: ALWAYS-⚑ #1: rate_of_fire and reloadFrames are known-unreliable datamine fields, and the effective rate is quantized to 60fps frame boundaries (60/ceil(60/nominal)). These set how often the skill1 hitCount:30 window completes (30 rounds out of a 60 magazine ⇒ two S1 procs per magazine plus reload dead time), so they drive S1 buff UPTIME, not just shot count.
flags.recipe: Ammo-counter read from a focus recording: count rounds/sec directly off the magazine counter (the instrument that measures the disputed quantity), and time full-magazine → full-magazine to get the real reload. Do NOT infer cadence from full-burst counts (downstream of gauge).

flags.estimate: 0 (branch inert at scope lock); worst case it would DOUBLE burst-bucket damage if it ever fired
flags.reasoning: The schema has no enemy-HP gate (requiresTargetStatus is name-keyed status, not an HP threshold), and the sim models no boss HP pool. Faithful-over-fit says record the line rather than credit an effect whose gate cannot be evaluated. In a 180s solo raid the boss is damaged well before the first Burst III cast, so the real-game branch should also be dead — but that is an inference from fight structure, not a measurement.
flags.recipe: Focus recording of a brid burst: if the burst produces ONE popup ≈1440%-scaled and never a paired second popup of equal size, the branch is confirmed dead and this stays unmodeled. If a doubled popup appears (e.g. an opening burst on an untouched boss), a target-HP gate primitive is required before modeling it.

flags.estimate: 30 rounds FIRED (engine hitCount), not 30 landed hits
flags.reasoning: The kit says '30 normal attacks'. The engine's hitCount counts rounds; for an AR (hitsPerShot 1, no pellet spread) fired and landed coincide in the sim, so the two readings are damage-identical here. Flagged only because the equivalence breaks if brid is ever given a shot-loss model.
flags.recipe: No action needed at scope lock; re-check only if an accuracy/landing model is introduced for ARs.
